fusions.name: Crushing Embrace
fusions.desc: Wraps chains around an enemy and crushes it for 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Into the Den
fusions.desc: Collapses a 5-tile line of chain ahead of you for 3 seconds that drags enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Baiting Roar
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Goaded in the Pit
fusions.desc: Each time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 36% in all, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
